modules.title: Minigame 23, Musical Mayhem: run round a ring of chairs while the music plays, sit when it stops, push to knock others off, one chair fewer than players, the last one sitting wins

blocks.title: The floor: a round arena, a ring of chairs one fewer than the players still in, bodies that bump and cannot walk through chairs
The music: plays for a time nobody can know, then stops; sit in an empty chair only once it has
The push: whoever is in front of you, knocked back and stunned a moment, off their chair if they were sitting
The rounds: once the chairs have stayed full a second, whoever is standing is out, a chair goes, until one is left
The controls: WASD to move, space to sit, left click to push
A still camera over the floor, chairs that close up as they go, the tune itself played while the music plays
One floor shared across the lobby, the host moving everybody from what they press, stand-ins only when alone
Contract, tests, MODULE.md
The assets: models, sprites and sound in place of primitives

nonGoals: No models: players are the island capsule, chairs are boxes
No moving camera
No music files: the tune is made in the browser
No score kept between games

modules.title: Minigame 15, Where's Midnight?: a junkyard at night and an all-black cat hidden in it, everybody at the same spot with their own camera, drag and zoom until you find her, click her to say so, and you place in the order everybody does

blocks.title: The junkyard: wrecks, tyres, drums, crates and bin bags scattered in a fan from the seed, the same in every browser, each with the boxes that stop a click
The cat: all black, beside or on top of a piece of junk, her head always in sight and never all of her, at every seed
The search: click her and you have found her, at that moment; click anything else and wait a second and a half
The controls: drag turns and keeps what you grabbed under the pointer, the wheel zooms towards it, left click says that is her
A camera that never walks, and a yard dark enough to hide her: three lamps, a low moon, and the junk instanced
One yard across the lobby, each with their own camera, the host settling every click and a find timed on the finder, stand-ins only when alone
Contract, tests, MODULE.md
The assets: models, sprites and sound in place of primitives

nonGoals: No models: the junk is boxes, cylinders, tyres and blobs, and the cat is spheres
No walking: the camera turns and zooms and never leaves the spot
No hints, no highlighting, no warmer-and-colder - looking is the whole game
No sound, no score kept between games

modules.title: Minigame 5, Pet Race: ten seconds to read five pets’ stats and pick one - or be given the fish - then three, two, one and thirty seconds to race them down a course of hedges, puddles and treats, boosting on a stamina bar that only some of them can afford

blocks.title: The five pets: speed, boost, stamina, how fast it regrows and how sharply the animal turns, none of them simply the best
The course: a fenced run from the seed, hedges to steer round, puddles that drag and treats that give stamina back
The choosing: ten seconds with every pet’s stats on the table, and the fish for anybody who does not choose
The race: three, two, one, then thirty seconds - momentum, boost that burns stamina, and the fish flopping on the line
The end: finishers by their time, everybody else by how far they got
The controls: WASD to move, hold left click to boost
A camera behind your own pet, the course drawn, and five animals built out of primitives
One course across the lobby, the host moving everybody from what they press, stand-ins only when alone
Contract, tests, MODULE.md
The assets: models, sprites and sound in place of primitives

nonGoals: No models: the five pets are built out of boxes, spheres and cones
No racer-on-racer collision: pets run through each other, so nobody can be blocked out of a win
No lap counting, no checkpoints: one run, one line
No sound, no score kept between games
